p1.descriptionHtml:
• Fabric: Soft-finished fabric, 95% polyester.
  • Family story: One reindeer onesie design for the whole family, from baby to mom and dad, made for Christmas morning, movie nights, and holiday family photos.
  • Print: Snowflake Reindeer is a red and white Fair Isle print with leaping reindeer, snowflakes, and small green trees and hearts.
  • Design details: Hood with reindeer ears and antlers, long sleeves, and black ribbed cuffs at the wrists and ankles.
  • Care: Follow the care instructions on the sewn-in garment label.
  • Size range: Baby 3-6 Months through Baby 12-18 Months, Child 2 Years through Child 12 Years, Mother S through Mother 3XL, and Father S through Father 3XL.

Snowflake Reindeer brings the whole family together in one festive hooded onesie, with baby, child, women's, and men's cuts in the same red Fair Isle print. Pick a size for each family member separately to build the matching Christmas look you need.

Each onesie is sold separately. Garment length is the full length of the onesie. Child sizes are labeled by age, and the Child 10 Years and Child 12 Years sizes run tall, so check the height column and compare chest, hip, and length with a onesie that fits well. Weight and waist measurements are not available.

Key Features:

  • Whole-family match: One reindeer onesie design in baby and child sizes plus women's and men's cuts.
  • Reindeer hood: Ears and antlers on the hood finish the festive look for photos.
  • Classic holiday print: Red and white Fair Isle bands with reindeer, snowflakes, and tiny trees.
  • Snug cuffs: Black ribbed cuffs at the wrists and ankles keep the one-piece neat.
  • Family size range: Four baby sizes, eight child sizes, six women's sizes, and six men's sizes; see the size chart for measurements.

Choose the sizes you need for a cozy Snowflake Reindeer Christmas together.

p2.descriptionHtml:
• Fabric: Soft-finished 100% acrylic knit with a knitted-in jacquard design.
  • Family story: One cheerful Christmas sweater for mom, dad, and the kids, made for tree trimming, holiday parties, Christmas morning, and family photos.
  • Print: Santa Tree Topper shows Santa on a wooden ladder placing a gold star on top of a green Christmas tree hung with red ornaments, with white snow dots across a bright red knit.
  • Design details: Long-sleeve pullover with a crew neckline, a white hem band and white cuffs, and a relaxed, loose fit.
  • Care: Wash gently in cold water and lay flat to dry to keep the knit soft and in shape.
  • Size range: Child 2 Years through Child 6-7 Years, and unisex Adult S through Adult 3XL.

Santa Tree Topper dresses the whole family in the same red holiday sweater, in child sizes and unisex adult sizes for mom and dad. Choose each person's size separately to build the matching family look you need.

Measurements are garment measurements in centimeters; chest is the full chest circumference, and child heights are the suggested wearer height. Hip and waist measurements are unavailable, and the chart gives no weight guidance, so check child height first and compare the chest, sleeve, and garment-length measurements with a sweater that fits well. Hand measuring can vary by 1-3 cm.

Key Features:

  • Whole-family match: One Christmas sweater in child sizes plus unisex adult sizes.
  • Santa tree-topper design: Santa on a ladder crowns a green Christmas tree with a gold star, framed by white snow dots on red.
  • Soft acrylic knit: A soft-finished 100% acrylic jacquard knit for fall and winter gatherings.
  • Relaxed pullover: A loose-cut crew-neck pullover with long sleeves and white trim.
  • Family size range: Five child sizes and six adult sizes; see the size chart for measurements.
